reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that detects and repairs malformed tool-call message history, including orphaned calls and invalid ordering, to recover failed agent conversations.

summaries.zh: 自动修复 DeepSeek Harness 中无效的工具调用消息配对与顺序，帮助因消息格式错误而中断的会话继续运行。
summaries.en: Automatically repairs invalid tool-call message pairings and ordering in DeepSeek Harness to help interrupted sessions continue running.

capabilities: Repairs invalid tool-call and tool-result message pairings
Injects synthetic error tool results for unresolved calls
Rewrites malformed session messages and retries certain failed requests
